text:
Your life nourishes my blood

and I love you to death, I love you; if I could

under black skies I would eat

your heart with lioness teeth.


Before knowing you I was a thief

and now I am a diminished prisoner.

How well my spring shines!

How my crown gleams on your brow!


Blood that is mine burns in your pupils

and between your lips each afternoon places

the sweet grapes with which Pan invites.


And meanwhile; flower without air, flower in grotto,

I squeeze all myself into you like a fruit

and between your hands my life goes away.

translation.title: Transfusion
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the bodily extremity of love as blood, fruit, hunger, and possession.
